ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; remind the driver that the cancellation/waiting fee requires the "I'm Here" tap and that GPS-verified presence alone does not satisfy the policy

rejected_claims.reason: NS-1(i) not met: driver_pressed_here_at is null [F6] and the driver admits he forgot to tap 'I'm Here' [F11]. The arrival indication Ryde requires before charging the fee never occurred, so the $6.61 no-show fee does not stand (NS-2).

GPS showing the driver within 200 m for 5 min 20 s [F2] and stationary 4 min at 38 m [F3] satisfies NS-1(ii)(iii) but not NS-1(i); the three conditions are cumulative, so presence alone cannot validate the fee.
The driver's 22:41 chat 'At the pickup point' [F9] is a statement, not the required 'I'm Here' tap; system records (timeline) override statements and confirm no tap [F6].
